question: From which Asian country did Ahmad Shah Abdali come to India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Afghanistan**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• Ahmad Shah Abdali was born in **1723 in the city of Herat**, which is in present-day** Afghanistan.**
 
• He was the founder of the **Durrani Empire**, which became one of the major powers in the region during the 18th century.
 
• He is best known for his invasions of India, particularly against the Maratha Empire.
 
• His most notable campaign was the **Third Battle of Panipat in 1761,** where he defeated the Marathas, significantly impacting the power dynamics in India.
